name: Amulet of Spell Conversion
body:
Aura moderate no school; CL 11th; Slot neck; Price 26,400 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This dull-metal amulet is octagonal in shape and etched with arcane runes and symbols. It allows a caster that prepares their spells to cast the spell conversion spell once per day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells spell conversion; Price 13,200 gp
